dedupe_keys.name: rumi energy demand and supply modelling platform

description: Rumi is an energy-system modelling platform from Prayas Energy Group. Its public guide describes two components: a detailed demand estimator and an optimiser for energy-supply sources. A modeller provides sectoral demand drivers, technologies, supply costs and other scenario inputs; the components can run separately or together to produce demand estimates and supply choices. Geographic and temporal coverage are set by the user's region and data, not by an included national case. Apache-2.0 source and release instructions are available on GitHub. The README states that demand and supply input datasets are not bundled, so a run requires data preparation. A limitation is that results cannot be assessed without knowing the assumptions and quality of those external datasets. Rumi can support electricity and fuel capacity planning. The catalogue's model-messageix-framework is a separate integrated energy model for comparison, not a Rumi dependency. No input files were downloaded and no platform run was attempted.
name: Rumi energy demand and supply modelling platform
